summary.text: Carmine Gentile is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives for the 13th Middlesex District, which includes the town of Sudbury and parts of Concord, Lincoln, Marlborough and Wayland.

The Legislature's committee listing shows him as Vice Chair of the Joint Committee on Higher Education and a member of the Joint Committees on Aging and Independence, Municipalities and Regional Government, and State Administration and Regulatory Oversight.
